heldout_seal.equivalence_rule: defining identifier and canonical name; a unique explicitly documented rule ID; application/implementation partners only when an explicit relationship is named in own documentation AND both reviewers accept inseparability; static adjacency alone is insufficient
heldout_seal.eligibility: >=20 alphabetic words and >=12 distinct words, original doc >=100 chars; no tests/generated/vendor/external; exclude all v1 entities/support/markers and original dev markers
heldout_seal.blindness: Implementing lead never opens v2 questions/keys/selected entities until final collection completes; author/reviewers alone see their prescribed packets

scoring: Original five: all frozen legacy markers; repaired dev/v2: any sealed equivalence marker, case-sensitive substring. No post-run key edits or citation-based score overrides.
fp4_decision: Keep default self-check only if paired ON yields at least one net additional correct answer and no additional wrong-graph/withheld. Pilot/final explicitly enable all recoveries as owner requested; report default recommendation separately.
closure: Exactly one cycle. Collect all raw batches before opening v2 keys; stop afterwards whatever result. No replacement, resume, merge or push.
